verdict.rationale: Jira's own docs name Slack as a connected tool for tracking progress and automation, and point to 3,000+ Atlassian Marketplace integrations, so the integration capability is first-party. However, GitHub and Google Drive are never named, and it is unclear whether those connections would be native or rely on third-party Marketplace apps. Missing for 10: explicit native GitHub integration, explicit native Google Drive integration, setup depth for Slack, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: Keep work up-to-date by tracking progress from your favorite tools like Slack, Figma and Gmail powered by an AI-assist
